Container.Name: UnRaiders-of-the-lost-Sta
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Instagram archiver. Download full-resolution posts, carousels, reels and stories from any account, with incremental sync, multi-cookie rotation, configurable parallel downloads, and detailed per-resource error logs. Instagram-inspired web UI.
Container.Description: Self-hosted Instagram archiver with an Instagram-inspired UI. Archives full-resolution images and reels, handles carousels and stories, syncs incrementally, rotates through multiple cookie files to dodge rate limits, and writes a detailed failure log for every resource that could not be downloaded.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership (Unraid default 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership (Unraid default 100 = users).

Config.Name: Download threads
Config.Description: Parallel download workers. Higher is faster but increases rate-limit/ban risk.

Config.Name: Max concurrent jobs
Config.Description: How many account scrapes run at once. Keep at 1 to minimise ban risk.

Config.Name: Rate limit min (s)
Config.Description: Minimum randomized delay between Instagram API requests.

Config.Name: Rate limit max (s)
Config.Description: Maximum randomized delay between Instagram API requests.

Config.Name: Cookie encryption key
Config.Description: Optional. Encrypts cookie files at rest (AES-256-GCM). Leave blank for plaintext. Generate with: python -c "import secrets,base64;print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode())"
